comment: Exact Arch Linux cloud image for the remote provider KVM acceptance. UNPINNED: no image has been accepted. A candidate and its provenance are in web-docs/docs/remote-provider-unit-test-plan.md ('Image provenance'); pinning is a separate, reviewed step. The harness refuses to execute while any field is null, and never substitutes a floating 'latest' URL. primary_key_fingerprint is the signing key's primary; signing_subkey_fingerprints are the subkeys approved to sign images (Arch's arch-boxes key signs with a subkey).
